name: Elif Demir
bio:
Elif Demir's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Istanbul, she initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering with a focus on automotive design. However, a summer internship at a local racing team ignited a passion for the precision and artistry involved in crafting high-performance racing machines. She quickly shifted her focus, immersing herself in machining techniques and materials science. 

Elif's approach to her work is meticulous and innovative. She believes that every component, no matter how small, contributes to the overall performance and reliability of the car. Her deep understanding of engineering principles, combined with a natural talent for problem-solving, allows her to create custom parts and modifications that push the boundaries of what's possible. She is known for her ability to quickly adapt to new challenges and develop creative solutions under pressure.

What sets Elif apart is her unwavering commitment to quality and her relentless pursuit of perfection. She approaches each project with a blend of technical expertise and artistic flair, ensuring that every piece she creates is not only functional but also a work of art. Her calm demeanor and collaborative spirit make her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and often pulled back in a practical bun or ponytail during work.
physical.description: Elif is of average height with a lean, athletic build and kind eyes that reflect her focused and thoughtful nature.

quirks: Always carries a small worry stone in her pocket.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate parts.
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when others are using imperial.
